messages:
maya: Quick sync — reworking the early-adopter welcome drip to include a webinar invite + segmented send path. Need owners, send windows, and suppression rules. TL;DR: three cohorts (power users, dormant signups, trial-expiring) with tailored subject/CTA. Target staging send Fri 9am PT. Thoughts?

sam: Love it. For power users I'd lead with something like 'Preview: latency & cost wins — exclusive webinar' — high signal. Who owns copy and subject variants? :thinking_face:

aaron: I can own copy + subject A/Bs. Will draft 3 subject lines and two preview-text options by Wed EOD.

jen: I can take routing and send windows. Proposal: NA send 9am PT, EU send 10am BST, APAC offset to next business day 9am SGT. Also recommend excluding Dedicated/Private accounts for this invite for compliance.

maya: @jen yes exclude Dedicated & Private. Also add a 'webinar_optout' tag to suppress follow-ups if they opt out.

sam: Segment rules sketch (pseudo-SQL):
```
SELECT account_id FROM users WHERE signup_segment = 'early_adopter' AND (
  CASE
    WHEN last_7d_activity >= 5 THEN 'power'
    WHEN last_7d_activity = 0 AND days_since_signup <= 14 THEN 'dormant'
    WHEN trial_ends_in <= 7 THEN 'trial_expiring'
  END IS NOT NULL
) AND account_tier NOT IN ('dedicated','private');
```

aaron: I'll wire draft copy into `/templates/welcome_v2` and include the one-click add-to-calendar link + calendar attachments. Product: can someone give me 2 bullets (latency benchmark + cost per token) to highlight?

maya: I'll ping product and drop the short brief in #product. KPIs: aim for 25% open on power users, 8% open on dormant cohort, and 15–20% webinar RSVP for power users. Use UTM: `utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ea-webinar-march`.

jen: Ops note — suppression & dedupe plan: remove anyone with `webinar_optout` or who clicked 'unsubscribe' in last 90 days. Also do a hard dedupe across accounts with multiple emails.

sam: Quick ask: include a 1-question feedback link in the footer post-webinar to measure net helpfulness. Also add simple event `ea_webinar_invite_sent` to our tracking.

ops-bot: Scheduling staging send to sandbox segment `ea_staging` for 2023-03-10 16:00 UTC. Confirmation: sched_abc123.

aaron: Thanks — I'll have copy ready by Wed morning so Jen can run the smoke and we can iterate on subject lines.

maya: I'll create the tracking sheet and ownership column, and link it here once done. :thumbsup:

jen: I'll add suppression lists and run a quick deliverability smoke Wed afternoon.

ops-bot: Staging send executed in sandbox: 1,820 simulated recipients, opens tracked, test calendar links validated. Log: send_sim_20230310_xyz.

sam: Nice. After staging, we'll roll to a small live cohort (5% power users) for canary, then full send if metrics look good.

maya: Perfect — thanks everyone. Will follow up with the sheet + product bullets.
